title: TX queue: make clear/destroy retryable on frame-pool release failure
description: Security review found that tx_queue_clear() ignores lichen_frame_pool_release() failures and marks entries invalid, while POSIX tx_queue_destroy() destroys the mutex before frame-pool destruction. A release failure can lose the live handle and then return EBUSY after synchronization is irreversibly destroyed, making retry unsafe. Preserve entry validity on release failure, expose/propagate clear failure, and order destroy operations so a failed destroy leaves a retryable object. Update every caller and declaration.
acceptance_criteria: Clear returns and propagates frame release errors without discarding live handles; destroy does not destroy queue synchronization until the frame pool is successfully releasable/destroyed; failure-injection tests prove retry succeeds; all declarations/callers/stubs compile and sanitizer-backed tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
